Subject: Redwood MAP & next steps / evaluation plan

Hi Asha and Tom,

Thanks again for taking the call today. Really appreciated the context on your search for a more predictable inference cost model and lower tail latency for your personalization pipeline. As promised, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines a proposed evaluation plan and timeline. High level items are:

- Technical eval: 2-week sandbox with sample traffic and metrics collection
- Success criteria: p50 p99 latency targets, cost per 1M tokens, and qualitative answer quality on 3 evaluation prompts
- Owners: Acme engineering (integration), Redwood solutions (onboarding + runbook)
- Procurement: proposed SOW and timelines for procurement to sign off

Attachments: Acme-Redwood-MAP-20260114.pdf, Redwood-Eval-Checklist.pdf

Request: Could you confirm the right owners on your side for integration and procurement, and whether the 2-week evaluation window starting Jan 26 will work for you? If that date is tight we can shift.

Next steps from our side: we will provision a sandbox and share temporary API keys, and Vivek will be assigned as your technical lead. I copied him here so he can follow up on integration details.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
